title: IKI Hospitality
summary: A shared Webflow system for two modern Japanese restaurant brands: IKI Ramen + Sushi and AKAMI. Each site has its own identity while sharing the same underlying structure for menus, reservations, locations, galleries, and storytelling.
description:
IKI Ramen + Sushi and AKAMI are two modern Japanese dining concepts operated by IKI Hospitality.
IKI Ramen + Sushi focuses on ramen, sushi, omakase, online ordering, and reservations across Hollywood and Koreatown. AKAMI focuses on sushi, omakase, a la carte dining, and reservations across Monrovia, Toluca Lake, and Arcadia.
Both websites were built from one shared system. The hero modules, menu structures, reservation blocks, location sections, galleries, and chef content could be adapted for each brand without duplicating the entire build.
caseSub: IKI Hospitality needed two restaurant websites that felt connected without feeling identical. The same component system was adapted for a ramen-and-sushi restaurant and a premium omakase concept across Los Angeles.

gallery.title: A ramen and sushi experience in Los Angeles.
Seasonal dishes and a structured tasting journey.
A dedicated sushi and omakase experience.
Lunch Omakase and the full Omakase Experience.
Five Los Angeles locations managed through one system.

decisionsHeading: The choices that held it together.
decisionsSub: The build needed to support two brands with different menus, locations, and customer journeys while remaining simple to manage and consistent to expand.

decisions.title: One system, not two separate builds.
decisions.body: The core components were shared across both websites, while each brand received its own content, visual treatment, menus, and messaging.

decisions.title: Flexible content structures.
decisions.body: The CMS was designed to support IKI’s ramen, sushi, and omakase content alongside AKAMI’s separate lunch and full omakase experiences.

decisions.title: Reservations as a reusable component.
decisions.body: The reservation structure was built to support multiple locations and booking providers without creating a new layout for every restaurant.

decisions.title: Distinct brands, related experiences.
decisions.body: IKI Ramen + Sushi and AKAMI feel like part of the same hospitality group while maintaining different personalities and dining propositions.

title: Quick Greens
summary: Fast-casual salad chain site with custom order and catering forms wired into their own systems, not a generic third-party embed.
description:
Quick Greens is a fast-casual drive-thru food concept serving bowls, wraps, salads, snacks, and drinks through drive-thru, delivery, and pickup.
The website gives visitors a quick way to understand the menu, browse house picks, compare calories and macros, find a nearby location, order online, and explore catering options. The content is organized around the ways customers interact with the brand: choosing what to eat, understanding what is in it, deciding how to order, and finding the nearest location.
The site also supports dietary discovery with vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options, explains the ingredients and preparation approach, and connects customers to ordering, catering, feedback, franchise, careers, and community updates. The project data also identifies custom forms and integrations as part of the build.
caseSub: A fast-casual food experience that helps customers choose, understand, order, and find their quickgreens meal without slowing them down.
galleryHeading: A quick path from craving to order.

gallery.title: Real Food Made Quick.
House picks, bowls, wraps, salads, snacks, and drinks.
Clean greens. Clear macros.
Find a quickgreens location near you.

decisionsSub: The site is built around the speed and clarity customers expect from a quick-service food experience.

decisions.title: Make the menu easy to scan
decisions.body: Menu categories, house picks, ingredients, dietary indicators, and nutrition information are presented in a way that helps visitors decide quickly.

decisions.title: Put nutrition in the experience
decisions.body: Macro information is treated as part of the menu experience, giving customers a clearer view of calories, protein, carbohydrates, fat, and sodium.

decisions.title: Support multiple ways to eat
decisions.body: The site connects customers to drive-thru, delivery, pickup, online ordering, and catering without forcing those journeys into one generic call to action.

decisions.title: Connect the forms to the business
decisions.body: Custom order and catering forms are part of the project’s integration work, keeping important customer actions connected to the systems Quick Greens uses to operate.

title: Kilo K-9™
summary: A dog-training website for pet owners, working-dog handlers, and families looking for structured, reliable training programs.
description:
Kilo K-9™ is a family-run dog-training company based in Flagstaff, Arizona. The website introduces visitors to obedience training, behavior modification, board and train, personal protection, service-animal training, and Kilo Select™.
The site serves two main audiences: owners looking for help with pet dogs and handlers looking for specialized working-dog training. Each service has a clear path so visitors can understand the difference between everyday obedience, behavior work, protection training, service-animal training, and longer-term development.
The website also introduces the Kilo K-9™ team, explains the company’s training philosophy, presents client testimonials, and guides prospective clients toward an inquiry.
caseTitle: Building Better Dogs. Guiding Better Handlers.
caseSub: A clear, structured website for pet owners, working-dog handlers, and families looking for the right training path.
galleryHeading: A clearer path through dog training.

gallery.title: Building Better Dogs. Guiding Better Handlers.

Obedience, behavior modification, board and train, protection, and service-animal programs.

decisionsSub: The site brings multiple training programs and audiences into one clear experience.

decisions.title: Separate the main audiences
decisions.body: The site gives pet owners and working-dog handlers clear routes into the services most relevant to them.

decisions.title: Make the services easy to understand
decisions.body: The training offer is divided into recognizable programs, including obedience, behavior modification, board and train, personal protection, service-animal training, and Kilo Select™.

decisions.title: Lead with trust and experience
decisions.body: The website places the trainers, client testimonials, company history, and training philosophy close to the service information.

decisions.title: Turn interest into an inquiry
decisions.body: Visitors are directed toward a consultation flow where they can identify their training needs and begin a conversation with the team.

title: Palm & Ocean
summary: A bold hospitality marketing website for Palm & Ocean, combining services, production work, client projects, team information, and lead generation into one editorial experience.
description:
Palm & Ocean is a hospitality marketing agency and production studio focused on helping restaurants, hotels, and hospitality brands grow through strategy, content, and creative direction.
The website brings together the agency’s services, production work, featured clients, team, and contact experience in one immersive platform.
Its content spans video production, photography, social media management, public relations, branding, influencer marketing, paid advertising, email marketing, reputation management, and website development.
caseSub: A visual digital experience for Palm & Ocean, a hospitality marketing and production agency helping brands create bigger waves.

decisionsHeading: Build the agency around its range.
decisionsSub: Palm & Ocean offers more than one service, so the website needed to make the full breadth of its capabilities easy to explore without overwhelming visitors.

decisions.title: Lead with a clear point of view.
decisions.body: The opening message immediately establishes Palm & Ocean as a hospitality marketing agency with a strong creative perspective.

decisions.title: Turn services into a catalog.
decisions.body: The service section organizes the agency’s capabilities into clear categories, from production and photography to public relations, branding, advertising, and web development.

decisions.title: Put production at the center.
decisions.body: The production section gives the agency’s visual work a prominent role, showing the quality and range of its creative output.

decisions.title: Connect work to conversion.

title: Stachehaus
summary: A premium website for Stachehaus, a Brooklyn-based creative agency focused on brand strategy, campaign development, photography, and film production.
description:
Stachehaus is a bespoke creative agency based in Brooklyn, New York. The studio works across brand strategy, campaign development, commercial photography, campaign production, and film.
The website presents the agency through a structured visual story, guiding visitors through its mission, capabilities, selected work, team, and contact experience.

decisions.title: Make the story the navigation.

decisions.title: Separate strategy from production.
decisions.body: The website presents brand strategy and production as distinct capabilities, making the agency’s offer easy to understand.

decisions.title: Let the work carry authority.

decisions.title: Use motion to support meaning.

title: Kyle Nutt

title: JANA
summary: A refined restaurant website for JANA, bringing together its Mediterranean coastal identity, menus, chef story, events, gallery, guest experience, and reservations into one immersive digital experience.
description:
JANA is a Mediterranean coastal restaurant in Torrance, California, inspired by the timeless character of the Amalfi Coast and shaped by the seasons of California.

The website brings together JANA's menus, chef, story, events, gallery, guest reviews, location, and reservation experience in one cohesive platform.

At the heart of the brand are five guiding principles — Grace, Soul, Harvest, Ocean, and Community — which inform the restaurant's approach to food, hospitality, and the overall guest experience.
caseSub: A digital experience for JANA, bringing Mediterranean coastal dining, California influences, and a global culinary perspective together in one visual platform.
overviewHeading: A digital home for the JANA experience.

gallery.title: Fresh. Vibrant. Coastal.
Mediterranean flavors with a global perspective.
Grace, Soul, Harvest, Ocean, Community.
A visual expression of coastal dining.
Don't just take our word for it.
The JANA experience awaits.

decisionsHeading: Build around the complete dining experience.
decisionsSub: JANA is more than a restaurant menu. The website needed to communicate the brand's culinary point of view, atmosphere, people, and hospitality experience while keeping practical actions such as viewing menus and making reservations easy to access.

decisions.title: Lead with the coastal identity.
decisions.body: The opening experience immediately establishes JANA through its “Fresh. Vibrant. Coastal.” positioning, creating a strong introduction to the restaurant before visitors move into its food and story.

decisions.title: Put the food first.
decisions.body: Signature dishes and chef favorites appear early in the experience, giving visitors an immediate taste of JANA's Mediterranean coastal approach and creating a visual connection between the brand and its food.

decisions.title: Give the story room to breathe.
decisions.body: The Our Story section expands beyond the food to explore JANA's connection to the Amalfi Coast, California's seasonal ingredients, global influences, and its five guiding principles: Grace, Soul, Harvest, Ocean, and Community.

decisions.title: Put the chef behind the experience.
decisions.body: Chef Christopher Lin receives a dedicated section that introduces his background, culinary philosophy, and the influences behind JANA's menu, adding a human layer to the restaurant's identity.

decisions.title: Let the visuals sell the experience.
decisions.body: The gallery gives JANA's food, interiors, and atmosphere a prominent role, allowing visitors to understand the character of the restaurant before they ever arrive.

decisions.title: Connect discovery to action.
decisions.body: Menus, reservations, events, location information, and contact details are integrated into the experience, giving visitors a clear path from discovering JANA to planning their visit.
